notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. GEOL 8L, Earth Science Lab, may be taken concurrently or following GEOL 8. GEOL 10L, Physical Geology Lab, may be taken concurrently or following GEOL 10. For more information, please visit: Department of Geology .
